metadata.datasource: Generated with spektrafilm_profile_builder 0.1.0 from digitised data-sheet curves. FUJIFILM Motion Picture Film manual KB-1101E (2011-02 (print code SK-11.02)), fujifilm_motion_picture_film_manual.pdf, PDF page(s) 10, FUJICOLOR ETERNA 250 8553 / 8653: https://vfxcamdb.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/fujifilm_motion_picture_film_manual.pdf Estimate placeholders (not on the sheet): spectral sensitivities and dye densities (minimum and mid-scale) are not in the manual: borrowed from fujifilm_f250_kb914e (tungsten EI 250 Fujifilm cine negative with its own data sheet, the stock ETERNA 250 replaced); the characteristic curves are printed against camera stops: converted to relative log H (1 stop = 0.30103), the absolute exposure scale comes from the builder's speed-point anchoring; spectral sensitivity on a relative log scale (one log unit = the interval marked '1.0'), absolute level from the builder's mid-grey anchoring; sensitivity tails beyond the printed curves; base+fog and mid-scale dye densities read from the sheet, individual CMY dyes reconstructed by the builder (not printed); dye densities outside the printed 400-700 nm; print stock: KODAK VISION 2383 (the shipped cine print profile; FUJIFILM ETERNA-CP 3513/3514 is not in the repository); interlayer DIR coupler strength (not on any data sheet; runtime default for negatives). Original data are property of the respective holders.
